title: What Are The Rare Qualities Of A Truly Good Woman
paragraphs: In this precious chapter, which the Holy Spirit has given us, we have discovered good things about God's attitude towards women and how he sees them as they should be. And how he gave us standards to live by so that we may know who the good woman is. I want you to get ready, bring your notebooks, and jot down some notes. In verse 10, it says: “A good woman, a virtuous lady, a good wife, a good potential wife is rare, like rubies and pearls.” The first thing we learned was that good women don't appear every week.

You have to look for them. They don't appear in every corner. You must search for them like precious jewels. They are like rubies. Sometimes good women are discovered in not-so-good places. Sometimes family circumstances are not at their best. But sometimes you find good women who come out of good circumstances, and other good women who come out of bad circumstances. Pearls come from things like oysters. Rubies come out of rocks.

Rubies, jewels, and precious stones come from the earth, but we wear them around our necks. We put them in small leather bags and hide them in drawers, but their origin was rock. Good things don't always come from good places. So, young lady, maybe your father is an alcoholic, or your mother is a lesbian, but you can still be a ruby. Don't let anyone tell you that your family determines your future or that the environment in which you grew up will determine who you will be. This is a lie.

You can choose who you will be and what you will be because you have the will to do so, and God will honor your decision. Decide to be a ruby. We also learn in this passage that this woman, as verse 11 says, is trusted completely by her husband and lacks nothing of value. She brings him good, not evil, all the days of her life, and she does not pressure him to ruin his life. You know that some women cannot tolerate it. They want to live like everyone else.

Therefore, they force their husbands to buy a house that exceeds their budget. This is a sin. This is not a good woman. The Bible says here that a virtuous woman does not force her husband to deviate. We also discovered that an immoral woman pressures her husband to engage in matters that are not necessarily in the best interest of the family. Some husbands are forced to steal to buy jewelry to satisfy an insatiable woman. The Bible says that this is not a devout woman at all.

A pious woman treats her husband well all the days of her life. Verse 13 says that she is not a lazy woman. She works with her hands. She spins and sews skillfully. Verse 14 says that they are like merchant ships. She does her best to provide for her family's needs. Verse 15 says: “She gets up while it is still night, prepares food, and provides assistance to her household.” She is not a lazy sleeper. She doesn't spend her day sleeping and wandering around in her pajamas.

She is not a woman who spends her day in her house slippers. In fact, she gets up before sunrise. She rises before the sun to provide for her household. Well, it seems that Mrs. Pilgrim wakes up before sunrise. I will check that. I'll call you at home, brother. I will call you at 4:30 in the morning to make sure. To see if she was awake. It's best if you stay awake, son. Otherwise, you will have to repent. People of the room, you heard what he said, didn't you? Don't forget what he said.

I will give you his phone number in a little while. Verse 16 says: “ She considers a field and takes it; she plants a vineyard from the fruit of her hands.” This is strange here. God encourages women to get involved in real estate. Some people think that a woman’s place is in the home, cleaning, taking care of the children, cooking, mopping the floor, and only engaging in marital relations. That is not what God is thinking. Of course, your church probably thinks so. But what does God think?

God says that a virtuous woman, an intelligent and capable woman, is a woman who can participate in decision-making processes and achieve economic gains. He says here that she plants a vineyard with her profits. This woman earns money. Then you go back and invest it in agriculture. This is a serious woman. She is a good woman. One of the qualities of a good woman is that she doesn't keep asking, "What do you think, Sam?" "What are your thoughts on this matter, brother?" "What do you think, my dear?"

A man wants a woman who thinks. Believe me, I am a man. A wise man, an intelligent man, likes to have an intelligent partner. Some men get tired of women who constantly ask for their advice. Don't misunderstand me, this does not mean that a woman should act on her own and make her own decisions. If you are married, you are in a contract. You are in what is called an employment contract. When a company is established, the shareholders in the company become partners.

What happens to the company, whether it is in everyone's best interest or not, depends on the decisions that are made. This is why companies have what are called board meetings to consult on decisions. If we in our company decide to purchase land, you do not go and pay a deposit for the land without consulting the company's board of directors. This is a board decision. But that doesn't mean you can't go and inspect the land and come back with a report stating that the land is good. It is not swampy land.

It is worth the investment and the asking price. It is in the right location and its value will increase. You can do that without taking the entire council there. This is what a good wife can do. She can go and see things for herself and then come to consult so that peace prevails in decision-making. She is an investor. It's making profits. We begin with verse 17 here. She says: "She is armed with strength and has her arms strengthened." Let everyone say: "Enthusiastically." Actively.

Raise your hands in the air, everyone. With both hands, just shake them. Do you see how active that is? This is the activity. Okay, you in the open room. I hope you did that. I saw you through the wall by faith. She is not a woman who wanders around lazyly. You know, the one who gets tired of cooking all these years. This lazy mentality. This situation is not a difficult one. I mean, she is active in her work. We have some women who wake up and throw the covers off the bed. They roll to the ground.

They say to the dog: "Go and bring me my slippers." Lazy women. Cooking. Complaining throughout the cooking process. He put a lot of sauce in it. This man does n't appreciate my cooking. Bad situation. You can always find out where she was. You can see her clothes lying all over the floor behind her. u smile. This woman is a very lively woman. I want to tell you something, ladies. The worst thing in the world you can do to a man of God is to be a lazy woman. Can you hear me? A lazy woman.

I understand why Jesus associated with certain women. They were not lazy. Mary and Martha, man, were clever and energetic women. If you read the scriptures carefully, you will find that they followed him and served his needs. They would cook for him, carry food in baskets, and follow him on major campaigns. They are energetic and lively. Every time my husband wants to go somewhere, I make excuses. Always tired. Oh man. Take some vitamin B or something like that, but gain some energy.

She accomplishes her work with enthusiasm and energy. She enjoys her work. Verse 17 says that her arms are strong for her task. Well, you should eat well to get strong arms. Do not follow a very strict diet. Welcome. Some women go on such a strict diet that they don't have the energy to serve their husbands. Always on a diet. Always follow a diet. I know some people who are on a permanent diet. Their service is following a diet. It's a diet service. Then they wonder why they are always tired.

Your body is like a machine. It needs oil and fuel to operate. And you ca n't operate with just air. Ah, how sad that is. You must have the strength to be a good woman. Do you understand? I take this slowly. Verse 19 says, or rather verse 18 says, that she sees her business as profitable. She knows good merchandise when she sees it, and some of your translations say that she knows her merchandise is good. Now, ladies and gentlemen, I want to say this cautiously. Some women don't know what they have.

I speak from experience. We know that some men don't know what they have. But what surprised me during my years of working in counseling is that some women don't know what they have. There are some couples. They are not angels, but they are not exactly devils either. And the women treat them as if they don't care. I know some men who would rob banks to provide pearls for them. They do all sorts of things to make her happy, and she doesn't care. These men do not appreciate them.

This woman knows that her merchandise is good. I think this refers to everything she owns, including her husband. She knows she has a good man and she makes him know it. Dear, I have a wonderful husband. You are a good man. Ah, how sad it is that women take their husbands for granted, just as husbands take their wives for granted. We shouldn't do that. Know your merchandise well, man. You can tell the quality when you see it in front of you.

Look, women look at other men who are well- dressed and think they are better than their husbands, but they are not. Don't let these men deceive you. There is no one better than your life partner. I tell you this from my own experience. No one is better than your wife or husband. Don't let anyone convince you otherwise. When you find someone who possesses the qualities of God, you should hold on to this good merchandise. This is correct. And you who are not yet married, remember this.

When you come across good merchandise, acknowledge its value. It may not come in the packaging you prefer, but it's still good merchandise. You can tell a good product when you see it. Search for the attributes of God and the qualities and virtues of the soul. That's good merchandise. Verse 19 says: “She stretches out her hands to the spindle.” She is a flirt. "This woman is not only involved in real estate and agriculture, but she is also a seamstress." I love women who sew their own clothes. Say: "Amen".

" Men, save a lot of money, brothers. You know, there are women who can't even hem their husbands' trousers. You must repent and start learning. This woman is a skilled seamstress. She spins. She doesn't just make clothes, she makes the fabric the clothes are made from. That's an educated woman. That's a clever woman. But I can sew. Learn, learn. It's a blessing. You will bless your husband if you learn to sew. I tell you, I buy my wife fabric every time. It's a great deal of fabric.

I just say to her, 'Darling, take this, I love you. This is fabric.' She tells you, I mean, if you want proof, the dress she's wearing right now, she made it. Hey photographer, take a picture of that. Look at this. My wife sewed this dress. Do you see? It's handmade. Amen. Is n't that beautiful? You know good things. This woman is a seamstress. She's not a lazy woman, she sews her own clothes. Her husband loves her for that. The text says she holds the spindle with her fingers and works hard.

She simplifies She opens her hands to the poor and extends them to the needy. Now, this is something many women lack. They are selfish. The woman of God, the virtuous woman, possesses the qualities of openness and generosity. There are women who feel that no one should walk on their carpets. Look me in the face right now. I won't invite them into my house. They'll soil my carpets. What an impious attitude! Don't sit on a chair. Sit on the floor, Sunni. Ah!

We do n't want to host anyone in our house because these people don't know how to behave with fine clothes and valuable things. Come on, observe these behaviors. The woman of God is a woman who invites the poor into her home. She opens her arms and says, "Come, come to my house." No, we buy a carpet for five thousand dollars and we don't even allow our children to walk on it with shoes on. Take off your shoes, Tommy. God says: " Beware. You will lose your prayer mat."

Also, people, women are sometimes selfish with their husbands. Now, hold on to your seats. O married people, be patient. You see another woman talking to him and you get angry. Welcome. I mean selfishness. You want to keep everything to yourself. You know, someone stands up and blesses him and hugs him in the Lord, and you start thinking about something vile. Stop being selfish. Yes.

The husband goes out and talks to some women in the group, and when he returns home you say why he continues to talk to these women, while the man's mind does not think of anything negative. There are no hidden intentions, but selfish thoughts do exist. This is my husband and this is my man. What do you mean by the word "my man"? This is my man, my son. Do not touch my man. He is the man of God. And the Lord has only lent you that man. The Bible says that in the New Jerusalem there is no marriage or betrothal.

So you won't even recognize him as your husband in the resurrection. It's mine. Don't look at him. He is my husband. Have you ever heard of anything like this before? It is a terrible selfishness that is being displayed publicly. But this woman of God opens her arms to the poor. Poor women and men can come to her house. She doesn't kick people out of her house. And don't say, "Don't drink from my good cup." "Use old cups." "No.

When someone comes to you, they come as an image of Christ, and you should offer them the best cup in the house. Isn't that right? The Bible says, ' If you give a poor person a cup of water in my name, you give it to me.'" Why would you choose your broken, plated cup to offer to Jesus? "Hello. And your wedding furniture and wedding dishes are hidden in a cupboard that you don't use yourself. I was telling my wife: "Bring out the best." Let's eat. Let's look at the flowers on it. "She's not a selfish woman.

She opens her home to the poor. So, you're still a virtuous woman. You're still a good woman. One of the qualities of a good woman is that she's not stingy. She doesn't buy chairs and sofas for herself. She buys them for the poor. What a blessing it is to buy expensive furniture, a beautiful sofa, and then bring someone who thinks they don't deserve the best and seat them on it. Make them feel like royalty. Amen. Bless someone with good things. How sad, how selfish.

If you want to be a good woman, buy the best and give it to those who are in the greatest need. Then you will elevate the minds of the poor. The poor will begin to believe that God is a good God, that He is a kind God who teaches us how to appreciate beautiful things. She opens her arms to the poor. I love that last part. It says she reaches out to those in need. She doesn't just invite them in, she feeds them too. She gives them things. She gives things away.

I know there are people, especially women, who hoard shoes. Hold on tight. Hoard." They keep shoes for years. They do n't wear them. Some of these women have dresses hidden away. They've only worn them once. One of them says, "I do n't like how they look on me," and hangs them in the closet. She doesn't move them. She leaves them there for years. And there are people sitting next to them who can't afford to buy such clothes, yet they don't give them away. Give them away to those in need.

Speaking of those in need, there are some women who don't know how to accept a gift. Don't think I've forgotten you. There are those who say, "I won't wear what she wore." It's better for you to be quiet and appreciate God's gift. Perhaps that's why you're still in need, if that's the case, because you don't accept the blessing. But the Bible says she is generous. She gives with the qualities of a good woman. This next line blesses me especially when I think of women who think they are so delicate.

Verse 21 says, "She will not fear the snow on her house, for all her household are clothed in scarlet." Underline the word crimson. Now, when it snows, it doesn't snow here in our area. So, we have to say when it's stormy, that's the kind of weather we have. When hurricanes come or when rain and thunderstorms start hitting outside, don't adopt an "I'm terrified" mentality. If I go out, I will melt. The text says, this woman is not afraid of snow or cold. She also knows that her family is completely safe.

It covers them in crimson. Scarlet is an expensive material that was worn by kings in the time of Solomon when this text was written. So, you're talking about a woman who believes in good things. Some women do not care about their appearance, but a woman of God cares about her appearance. She doesn't just wear anything. Rather, she tries hard to obtain crimson or something close to it. Sometimes I wonder how some women expect their husbands to introduce them to others. I'm serious about that.

I see some women and I wonder, and I see men hiding behind other people. This is not my wife, man. That's just how it looks. Can you imagine bringing a friend over to visit your home and your wife coming out looking like she just came out from under the rocks? Good morning. Oh, hello. You brought someone with you. Good. Would you like something to eat? Let me bring my slippers. This is the style of some women. Some men are afraid to bring their friends home because they might run into a monster.

Hair curlers, dark circles under the eyes, and nails in different colors. This woman here in the Book of Proverbs is an elegant woman. She loves the color crimson. She gives her children good clothes and wants them to look presentable. Why? Because they represent it. Watch this. It gets even more amazing. The text says that she makes covers for her bed. The word “ cover” means that it covers it and adds a personal touch to these covers. Do you know how much a man appreciates handmade items from his wife?

He feels proud. She makes it herself and arranges the bed. I mean, some women don't even bother to arrange it. The man buys the things and they still haven't made the bed. They don't even have to make it now. The man presents it to them ready-made. Here is the pillow cover. And here is the sheet. However, they still don't make the bed. This woman does not just make the bed. Rather, it makes the items that are used to furnish the bed. The qualities of a virtuous woman.

She goes beyond what is expected, what is considered her duty, or what she sees as her service to her husband. Her husband is respected in social gatherings. Now why is he respected? You need to read verse 22 and understand the reason. The text says: " She makes herself a turban." Not only for bedding, but she is also dressed in luxurious linen and purple. And purple, as we know, was a royal color in the days of Solomon as well. Linen is the most expensive material in the East. This woman was wearing the best.

Do you know what I like? I like to see a woman who looks exactly like the image of God. She wears elegant, well-groomed clothes and styles her hair in a manner befitting the representation of God. She walks with dignity. It has a pleasant fragrance. She speaks eloquently and wisely, and behaves like a princess and a queen. These are the qualities of a good woman. When you read this, you start to wonder. Some women say, "I am a Christian." God bless.

If you understand the terminology used here in verse 23, you will appreciate what I am saying. When he says here, her husband is known at the doors. The city gate is the place that represents the seat of government, or as we call it, the seat of judicial proceedings. It is the place where the officials in charge of running the city used to sit. This does not mean that they were sitting in the road by the gate. The word gate here refers to a complex of buildings.

The city walls were three times larger and wider than this room. The walls were so huge that they drove chariots over the top of the city walls. These walls resembled streets. Many judges lived within the walls of the gate. Many of those involved in politics lived in the gate. This is where you used to do all your work in order to enter the gate. The gateway was the center where the economy was managed. It is the place where all the merchants used to come to complete their deals at the gate.

If you read the Bible carefully, you will usually find blind people around the gates because that is where people come with money to complete transactions. The man referred to here in this text is a businessman, and he is clearly one of the city's top officials, and he is well known, as the text says. Now, why is it mentioned in the context of our discussion about her clothes? Because when this man goes to work, he doesn't want to hear his colleagues say, "We saw your wife yesterday. Oh my God, she looked terrible.

Her hair was all messed up, and she was dragging her shoes down Baytown Street." They say, "Man, you're a respected official in this city and your wife isn't helping you at all." She is not a support for you. On the contrary, the text says that he was respected at the gate. She was behaving in a way that made him proud of her. He rejoiced in the fact that he could say to them, "That's my wife. Do you see that elegant lady over there? That's my sweetheart. That's my dear wife. The wife of my youth."

They respected him because of her. The text says that he sits among the elders of the land. He was an official in the city. "Then act according to this position." This woman is a manager or supervisor. She is the type of person who is not afraid to take responsibility. I pray that everyone who comes to the body of Christ will realize that they are meant to prosper. There are different levels of prosperity, but they are supposed to prosper.
